Now gate.ts — the big rewrite with all rules (fixes 5, 6, 12, 13):

Rules:
1. canSubmit false → reject (warning? reject as before).
2. Slots: `entry.remainingOnMarket` used directly. Only subtract in-flight claims not yet submitted when batching — we pass optional inFlightClaims (default 0).
3. restricted warning; empty pot warning.
4. stance lock.
5. dedupe.
6. links: >= 1, https/wellformed, DOMAIN DENYLIST (prediction markets/bookmakers: delphi.fyi, manifold.markets, polymarket.com, metaculus.com, kalshi.com, predictit.org, oddschecker, betfair, williamhill, bet365, bwin, unibet, draftkings, fanduel).
7. figures >= 2.
8. banned content + judge-manipulation phrase linter (banned: "please consider", "judge in favor", "favor this submission", "highest rating", "award me", "you should", "as a judge", "reward this", "generous", plus bookmaker URL).
9. Edge >= 2.5pp.
10. Item count: 1 + links.length + files.length <= 3.
11. Note length <= 8000 (note text passed in ctx).
12. File size <= 10MB (per file, CSV here tiny; passed via ctx.fileSizes).
13. asOf freshness: |now − asOf| <= 2h.
14. Freshness vs market resolution baseline: each sourceDoc fetchedAt must be > baseline ts parsed from resolutionCriteria ("strictly after <ts>"); docs fetchedAt < evidenceCutoffAt.

Gate gets ctx: {market, entry, log, inFlightClaims?, note, fileSizes(number[], bytes), sourceFetchTimes: Date[], now}.

Parsing the baseline: /strictly after (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[^\s]+?)(?=\s|and|\.)/ — first match in resolutionCriteria. Guard try/catch.

Direction sanity check kept.

Note: verifySources also runs link fetch checks (separately, pre-gate). The gate gets `fetchedAt` array which pipeline passes from refresh docs + verify fetches.

Write gate.ts now.

Interface: `verifySources(spec, api|sources, opts: {progress: docs?, fetchEach})`. It fetches each link fresh (this IS the same run) — mock mode returns fixtures so no cost. Fresh fetch also gives fetchedAt for the gate context. Return {ok, failures, docs: Map url→doc, fetchTimes}.
